text:
Anya: quick q — thinking about the autofallback policy UI: should operator inbox show grouped 'fallback events' or per-request breadcrumbs?
Sam: grouped, with heatmap + sample link. per-request details on demand. keep inbox low-noise.
Marta: +1. also need clear reason: latency vs error vs quota. right now error codes are opaque.
Anya: exactly — propose "degrade reason" enum in UI: latency_sla, model_error, infra_error, quota_exceeded, policy_match. tie to rollout rule id.
Kevin: how do we surface sampling? we don't want to blow up audit logs. prefer sampled full-trace with TTL.
Sam: add sampled_trace_id and a collapsed "view trace" that fetches the full payload on click. store only metadata in inbox.
RolloutBot: notice: new fallback event sampled (id: fb_17399_x7) — reason=latency_sla, tier=dedicated, sampled=1
Anya: UX question: operator action buttons — should we allow 'un-fallback' or 'ack-only'? my vote ack-only + escalation link.
Marta: ack-only. un-fallback dangerous without rollback plan. maybe 'start rollback playbook' button that opens runbook.
Sam: we also need telemetry counters on UI: fallback rate, stable traffic, avg recovery time. place them next to rollout toggle.
Anya: plus small 'why did you fallback' tooltip with signal breakdown: p95 latency, error-rate, quota hits.
Kevin: about triggers: policy currently fires on either 5xx > 0.02 OR p95 > 1200ms over 1min. can we make hysteresis? 2 consecutive windows to avoid flapping.
Marta: yes — and show "cooldown" indicator in console. otherwise ops keep toggling.
Anya: final — audit: every operator ack/un-fallback/rollback must write comment. require minimal two-line free text. store with event id and actor.
Sam: ok I'll mockup panels: inbox list, heatmap, sampled trace modal, action button flow. will share Figma link later.
Anya: thanks — also callout to infra team to expose reason codes in /admin/events API (cc @sam if anyone else).
Kevin: pinging @rota-bot to add SRE oncall to escalation list.
RotaBot: added SRE-oncall to escalation for rollout-policy alerts.
Marta: leaving a note — keep in mind quotas: when fallback due to quota we should surface customer id + plan.
Anya: good catch. ok let's schedule a 30m sync after Sam's mock.
Sam: mostly done, dropping initial mock in #design in 30m :thumbsup:
